assets.description: Indoor arena, parquet court, court markings, net, referee stand, LED boards, tiered stands, instanced seats and crowd, roof trusses.
Stylized-realistic volleyball athlete mesh with uniform, limbs, face, hair, shoes, and jersey number texture.
Volleyball shell with curved panel seams.
Spike impact and landing dust particle effects.
Mobile-tuned Three.js renderer, isometric camera, lighting and rally animation integration.

limitations: Player models are procedural meshes, not rigged GLB.
Current character animation uses group-level movement, not skeletal animation.
Final GPU rendering must be verified on target Android devices over HTTPS.
